label: Members without 2FA
means: Org members with two-factor authentication off. A count, never a login.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Requiring two-factor authentication in your organization (https://docs.github.com/en/organizations/keeping-your-organization-secure/managing-two-factor-authentication-for-your-organization/requiring-two-factor-authentication-in-your-organization, read 2026-11-26); GitHub Docs, REST API endpoints for organization members (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/orgs/members, read 2026-11-26), filter 2fa_disabled
source: state: gh api orgs/<owner>/members?filter=2fa_disabled, every page; the filter answers org owners only

params.comment: owner: the GitHub org read; empty means the quality config's owner.

label: Least base permission
means: Whether the base permission every member gets on every repo is none or read.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Setting base permissions for an organization (https://docs.github.com/en/organizations/managing-user-access-to-your-organizations-repositories/managing-repository-roles/setting-base-permissions-for-an-organization, read 2026-11-26); template goal: read or none, and more access by team
source: state: gh api orgs/<owner>: default_repository_permission; not measured without an org owner's admin:org token

label: One read
means: Seconds this tab's collector takes to read the org's members and base permission.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Best practices for using the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26), asks for serial requests; template goal: a few serial reads finish in seconds
source: wall time of this tab's collector, first request to last

label: API requests per read
means: gh api requests one read of the org's members and base permission spends.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Rate limits for the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26): GITHUB_TOKEN gets 1,000 requests per hour per repository; template goal: one read spends a hundredth of that
source: gh api requests this tab's collector made, one per page
